name: WorkIndex
note: general word: test menu cursor line, hardware-test step (HwTestStepTable), 300-frame count set at $C11202

name: WorkIndexNew
note: test mode: new cursor line before TestMenuDrawCursor

name: FrameWaitFlag
note: set by WaitFrame, cleared by SystemInt1 (VBlank) after MessOut and SystemIo

name: BIOS_SYSRET_STATUS
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: function code that SYSTEM_RETURN runs (0-6, SystemReturnModes); the low byte of the word BIOS_SYSTEM_MODE

name: BIOS_INT1_FRAME_COUNTER
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: frame counter of SystemInt1

name: BIOS_INT1_SKIP
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: when non-zero, SystemInt1 only does the calendar check

name: BIOS_FRAME_COUNTER
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: long incremented by every SystemIo call

name: BIOS_COMPULSION_FRAME_TIMER
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: frame countdown (59) of the start compulsion; BIOS_SELECT_TIMER counts the seconds

name: Credits
note: BCD credit count: CountCoin adds the credits of a coin rate (at most 99), DeductPlayerCredit and CreditDownPlayer take 1 (MAME: 07 -> 06 on a start); CreditCheck compares it

name: CurrentSlot
note: backup RAM: slot number written by SwitchSlot together with REG_SLOT; SystemMode2 prints it as SLOT n

name: SlotTable
note: 8 entries of 4 bytes: NGH and game index ($FFFF = none yet) of each slot, then the games kept past the slot count; the date of each entry $20 bytes further (LastBootDate format). Seen in MAME with the slots_* chain

name: BiosWorkRam
note: start of the BIOS work RAM, loaded into a5 (A5_BASE) by every BIOS entry

name: WorkRamStart
note: first byte of the 68000 work RAM ($100000-$10FFFF, game area below BiosWorkRam); the card utility points BIOS_CRDPTR here as its card data buffer ($4000 bytes for CARD 2); ChecksumLoop writes its result byte here; start address of the work RAM tests

name: BIOS_CREDIT_DEC1
note: NeoGeoDev wiki CREDIT_CHECK / BIOS RAM locations: credits asked for player 1, cleared by CREDIT_CHECK when not enough

name: BIOS_CREDIT_DEC2
note: NeoGeoDev wiki CREDIT_CHECK: credits asked for player 2 (reached as 1(a0) from BIOS_CREDIT_DEC1)

name: BIOS_STATCHANGE_RAW
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: Select and Start of P1-P4, positive logic (bit 0 Start P1, bit 1 Select P1, ...)

name: NeoClnSlot
note: slot holding a NEO-CLN (cartridge calendar) cartridge, $FF = none (power-on writes $FFFF); set by CheckCartridgeId, read by HardwareTest (open on the calendar screen) and HwTestCalendar (D also sets the cartridge calendar)

name: BackupRamSignature
note: 16 bytes compared with BackupRamOkText (BACKUP RAM OK !) by BackupRamTest; CheckCartridgeId clears the first long for a NEO-CLN or NoGoIdText cartridge so the next boot runs ClearBackupRam (C: MAME, five boots sharing one nvram)

name: SlotNumberMode
note: word, cleared at every power-on ($C11DD0), set to 1 by CheckCartridgeId for a NoGoIdText cartridge. When set: SystemMode2 shows SLOT n for 300 frames (SELECT P1 skips) instead of the boot animation, CheckSettingMode does not switch to the saved slot, the power-on slot list keeps duplicate games ($C12044), and DemoEndCheck lets SELECT end the demo without credits. MAME: scenario nogo_cartridge

name: Coin1Coins
note: CabinetSettings COIN1: coins (1-9); BackupRamDefaults 1

name: Coin1Credits
note: CabinetSettings COIN1: credits (1-9); default 1

name: Coin2Coins
note: CabinetSettings COIN2: coins (1-9); default 1

name: Coin2Credits
note: CabinetSettings COIN2: credits (1-9); default 2

name: GameSelectFree
note: CabinetSettings GAME SELECT: 0 ONLY WHEN CREDITED, 1 FREE; DemoEndCheck lets SELECT end the demo without credits when set

name: NoStartCompulsion
note: 1 when GAME START COMPULSION is 00 (WITHOUT); set by CabinetSettings, read by SystemMode2 and DemoEndCheck

name: StartCompulsionTime
note: CabinetSettings GAME START COMPULSION: seconds, BCD 00-59; default $30

name: DemoSoundOff
note: CabinetSettings DEMO SOUND: 0 SET UP IN EACH GAME, 1 WITHOUT

name: LastBootDate
note: BIOS_YEAR.. of the last power-on: when the date differs, the power-on code stores the new date and advances BookDayIndex

name: BookDayIndex
note: index (0-35) of today's record in the 36-day book keeping rings; ClearBackupRam sets $23

name: CodeNumber
note: code number (4 digits, one per byte, $0F0F0F0F mask) set by TestCodeNumber; must equal +$70 of a 1M card for Card1MSaveCabinet; default $F0F0F0F0

name: CabinetNumber
note: cabinet number of this board on the 1M card, $FFFF = none yet (Card1MSaveCabinet takes the next one); default $FFFF

name: GameSoftDips
note: 16 bytes of soft DIP values per game (index from the slot table), copied to BIOS_GAME_DIP; written by SoftDipSave

name: GameNames
note: 16-byte name per game (index from the slot table), shown in the TestSoftDip and TestBookKeeping lists

name: BookGameDays
note: per game ($240 bytes each): 36 daily book keeping records of 16 bytes (plays, continues, play time)

name: BookGameMonths
note: per game ($C0 bytes each): 12 monthly book keeping records of 16 bytes

name: BookCoinDays
note: CABINET/COIN: 36 daily records of 16 bytes (COIN1, COIN2, SERVICE)

name: BookPlayDays
note: CABINET/PLAY: 36 daily records of 16 bytes

name: BookCoinMonths
note: CABINET/COIN: 12 monthly records of 16 bytes

name: BookPlayMonths
note: CABINET/PLAY: 12 monthly records of 16 bytes

name: SlotCount
note: number of slots (2, 4 or 6) set by PowerOnSetup from REG_SYSTYPE bit 6 and REG_STATUS_A bit 5

name: EyecatchSlot
note: first slot whose cartridge leaves the eyecatcher to the system ROM (CART_EYECATCH_FLAG 0), $FF = none (ScanSlots)

name: ClockHour4
note: hour of the software clock x 4 (HourClockTick), index of the hourly start counters

name: ClockMinute
note: minute of the software clock (HourClockTick)

name: ClockSecond
note: second of the software clock (HourClockTick)

name: ClockFrames
note: VBlank countdown (60) of the software clock

name: PlayTimeSeconds
note: play time counted by PlayTimeCount while a game runs, added to the records by BookAddPlayTime

name: BookSlot
note: slot whose game the book keeping pointers and the per-game helpers use (GetGameDaysPtr..)

name: BookGameTodayPtr
note: pointer to today's record of the current game in BookGameDays (NextSlot)

name: BookGameTotalPtr
note: pointer to the current game's record at $D09B20 + index x 16

name: BookTodayPtr
note: pointer to today's record in BookCoinDays (PowerOnSetup); +$240 is today's CABINET/PLAY record

name: BookMonthPtr
note: pointer to this month's record in BookCoinMonths; +$C0 is this month's CABINET/PLAY record

name: BookGameDayIndex
note: 8 bytes: today's day index (0-35) for each game index (BookNewDayPerGame)

name: RemovedGames
note: 8 entries of 8 bytes (NGH, game index, date): games of the old SlotTable no longer in a slot (SlotListRemoved); seen in MAME with the slots_* chain

name: BookGameMonthPtr
note: pointer to this month's record of the current game in BookGameMonths

name: BookGameHoursPtr
note: pointer to the current game's 24 hourly start counters (GetGameHourCountsPtr)

name: BookGameDayCount
note: one long per game index, +1 on each new day while the game is in a slot

name: GameBackupData
note: $1000 bytes per game index: copy of the game's backup area (SaveGameBackupData, NextSlot)

name: BIOS_P3STATUS
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations (P3 block, $10FDA0-$10FDA5); ControllerSetup writes it. With a mahjong controller on P1 (BIOS_P1STATUS 3), WaitFrameGetP1 reads its extra key rows from this block

name: BIOS_P3PREVIOUS
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations (P3 block); WaitFrameGetP1 reads it for a P1 mahjong controller

name: BIOS_P3CURRENT
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations (P3 block); WaitFrameGetP1 writes it for a P1 mahjong controller

name: BIOS_P4STATUS
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations (P4 block, $10FDA6-$10FDAB); ControllerSetup writes it

name: BIOS_CREDIT_DEC3
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: credits asked for player 3 (CreditCheck)

name: BIOS_PLAYER_MOD1
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: player 1 status set by the game (0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue shown, 3 game over); PlayTimeCount copies MOD1-4 to PlayerModPrevious each frame

name: PlayerModPrevious
note: BIOS_PLAYER_MOD1-4 of the previous frame (PlayTimeCount): play time counts while P1 or P2 is 1 (playing); DeductStartCredits and CreditDownCount read it per player; CallUser clears it

name: PlayerModPrevious2
note: player 2 byte of PlayerModPrevious

name: BIOS_CARD_MODE
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations ("internal use?"): CardErrorFull keeps the CARD function in it and CardRestoreRequest puts it back in BIOS_CRDF; CardErrorNotFormatted reads and writes it

name: CardErrorResult
note: CardError stores the CARD result here; CardErrorFull swaps it with BIOS_CRDRESULT around its own CARD calls

name: BIOS_CRDPTR_LO
note: low word of BIOS_CRDPTR: CardUtilCopy copies it to BIOS_CRDSIZE after a CARD call (the size of the data read, kept there by the CARD function)

name: BIOS_CRDNGH_LO
note: low byte of BIOS_CRDNGH (NGH number); the directory search compares the two bytes one by one

name: BIOS_FRAME_COUNTER_LO
note: low word of BIOS_FRAME_COUNTER (SoundSlotSwitch times its wait with it)

name: BIOS_FRAME_COUNTER_LSB
note: lowest byte of BIOS_FRAME_COUNTER: bit 0 picks which LED counter SystemIoMvs refreshes, bit 6 paces the I/O check

name: BiosScreenActive
note: $FF while a system ROM screen runs (test mode, hardware test, HOW_TO_PLAY, eyecatcher end, card check, 1M card recover), cleared after: PlayCoinSound then sends sound command $7F instead of calling the cartridge's coin sound

name: CardErrorSavedMode
note: CardError keeps BIOS_SYSTEM_MODE (word) here while it shows its message and puts it back at the end

name: CardErrorTimer
note: frames left (900 = 15 s) before a card message ends by itself on an MVS (PushAnyButtonText, CardErrorFull)

name: CardSavedPtr
note: CardErrorFull: the game's BIOS_CRDPTR (CardRestoreRequest puts it back)

name: CardSavedSize
note: CardErrorFull: the game's BIOS_CRDSIZE

name: CardSavedNgh
note: CardErrorFull: the game's BIOS_CRDNGH

name: CardSavedFile
note: CardErrorFull: the game's BIOS_CRDFILE; also the file number in CardUtilCopy

name: CardTitleBuffer
note: buffer for a data title read with CARD 5 (CardErrorFull list, card utility FORMAT and COPY)

name: CardErrorScreenSaved
note: 1 while CardErrorSaveScreen holds the game's fix layer at $10F300; CardError clears it

name: IoCheckActive
note: 1 during the hardware-test I/O check: SystemIoMvs leaves the LEDs to it, DemoEndCheck waits

name: TestModeActive
note: 1 in test mode, the hardware test and the 1M card recover: coins still give credits (CountCoin, CountService) but are not added to the book keeping, and the coin counters are not pulsed

name: BIOS_BRAM_USED
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: 1 while the system ROM is using backup RAM (unlocked), 0 otherwise

name: HowToPlayAnimPtr
note: HowToPlay: pointer into the animation data after HowToPlayPalettes

name: HowToPlayAnimTimer
note: HowToPlay: frames left on the current animation step

name: BIOS_TITLE_MODE
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: set to 1 by newer games in their USER title command; CheckSettingMode and DemoEndCheck test it

name: MessOutStackPtr
note: MESS_OUT call stack pointer (MessOutCall pushes the list pointer, MessOutReturn pops it); MessOut resets it to MessOutStack

name: MessOutStack
note: MESS_OUT call stack (MessOutCall / MessOutReturn)

name: SlotSwitching
note: 1 while the slot is being switched or checked (CardStillInserted, SoundSlotSwitch): PlayCoinSound then plays no coin sound

name: BIOS_STATCURNT_RAW
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: START and SELECT bits of every player (positive logic); ReadControllers writes it

name: SysTypeInputs
note: REG_SYSTYPE inverted, as read by SystemIoMvs (bit 7: the test button)

name: SysTypeNew
note: bits of SysTypeInputs that became 1 this frame: the test button pressed outside test mode jumps to TestModeEntry

name: CompulsionStart
note: 1 while the system ROM starts the game by itself because the start compulsion time ran out (CheckPlayerStart); cleared when the start is taken

name: BIOS_FRAME_SKIP
note: NeoGeoDev wiki BIOS RAM locations: frames to skip in the demo-end / start check; decremented by SystemIo

name: CoinSoundCount
note: coins whose sound is still to be played (SystemIoMvs adds 1, PlayCoinSound plays one per frame)

name: Card1MRecoverFlag
note: set to 1 by Card1MRecover; nothing reads it

name: SysP1Status
note: the system ROM's own copy of the P1 input block (6 bytes, as BIOS_P1STATUS..), kept by CopyControllerState; a mahjong controller is turned into joystick bits

name: SysP1Current
note: inputs of P1 this frame in SysP1Status (Card1MRecover tests A-D held)

name: SysP1Change
note: P1 inputs just pressed, in SysP1Status (eyecatcher, HOW_TO_PLAY, code number, 1M card recover)

name: SysP2Status
note: the system ROM's copy of the P2 input block (CopyControllerState)

name: MessBuffer
note: start of the MESS_OUT command buffer: BIOS_MESS_POINT is reset to it; the system screens also build their lists here

name: WorkIndexLo
note: low byte of WorkIndex

name: CardRomType
note: $FF after Card starts; for an SNK ROM card, the type byte of its header (+$10, IsSnkRomCard); CodeNumberWrite refuses a card whose high nibble is not 0

name: BIOS_GAME_DIP_06
note: byte 6 of BIOS_GAME_DIP (the first option of the soft DIPs): NextSlot sets it to 1 when the cabinet's DEMO SOUND is off and the word BIOS_GAME_DIP held 5 before the copy (meaning not found)

name: CardFillTitleLast
note: last byte of the title CardFillTest copies to WorkRamStart; +1 on each save

name: CardFillFile
note: file number counter of CardFillTest (0-15)

name: CardUtilTitles
note: card utility: the titles read from the card (24 bytes each: 20-byte title, NGH, file number; CardUtilReadTitles)

name: BackupRamStart
note: start of backup RAM (the power-on RAM test)

name: CoinInputsPrevious
note: REG_STATUS_A inverted, the frame before CoinInputs (SystemIoMvs)

name: CoinInputs
note: REG_STATUS_A inverted, this frame: bit 0 coin 1, bit 1 coin 2, bit 2 service (I/O check shows bits 0-2)

name: CoinInputsNew
note: bits of CoinInputs that became 1 this frame (CountService tests bit 2)

name: CoinCounts
note: coins inserted toward the next credit, one byte per coin slot (CountCoin, which also adds 1 to CoinCounterPending, 8 bytes further, for the mechanical counter)

name: CoinCounterPending
note: pulses still to send to each of the 2 mechanical coin counters (SystemIoMvs sends one at a time)

name: Credits2
note: shown on the second LED counter instead of Credits on every other frame (SystemIoMvs); nothing in the code writes it

name: CoinCounterPulse
note: countdown of the current coin counter pulse ($1F): bit 4 set = counter on (REG_SETCC1), else off (REG_RESETCC1)

name: CoinCounterIndex
note: coin counter (0 or 1) being pulsed

name: PlayTimeFrames
note: frame countdown (59) of the play time (PlayTimeCount adds a second to PlayTimeSeconds when it underflows)

name: LastBootMonth
note: month byte of LastBootDate (a new month advances the monthly records)

name: BramA4Base
note: a4 points here for backup RAM accesses (lea BramA4Base,a4): names in the upper half are written (NAME-A4_BASE,a4)

name: BookGameTotals
note: 16-byte record per game index: its totals (BookGame, NextSlot, RegisterNewGame)

name: StartCompulsionFrames
note: second byte of the StartCompulsionTime word: 59, copied with it into BIOS_COMPULSION_FRAME_TIMER (the frames of the current second); both cabinet pages set it

name: BookGameHours
note: per game ($60 bytes each): 24 longs, the starts counted in each hour of the software clock (DeductPlayerCredit through BookGameHoursPtr); reached only through BookGameHoursTable; not shown by the test mode
